name: social-app
description: The Bluesky Social application for Web, iOS, and Android

issues.title: Message to our translators: Crowdin is now integrated!
Add a "don't scroll with load new" option
Option to redirect from the bsky.social handle to a custom domain instead of freeing the bsky.social handle
Posts containing images without alt text – add a native setting to hide from feed
User-created public and private Lists to curate user experience as well as help build community

latest_release.name: v1.137.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Split the react-native patch into one file per change by @tomekzaw in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12143
* Block more shortener and redirect domains in profile links by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12144
* Suggest a standard.site blog's own title for profile links by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12145
* Fix missing paper plane icon in chat send button by @ds-boyce in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12149
* Fix iOS e2e flows (create-account, login, thread-muting) by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12138
* APP-3524: Upgrade to React Native 0.88 / Expo SDK 58 by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12057
* Use Node 24.22 Docker tags and validate runtime versions by @rafaeleyng in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12148
* Fix text entry for TokenField by @ds-boyce in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12151
* Update CI certificate handling and Claude Bun runtime by @estrattonbailey in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12154
* claude: use Opus 5.5 for PR review workflow by @amckinley in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12158
* claude: use Opus 5.5 for mention workflow by @amckinley in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12159
* Share bsky.app passwords with bsky.social and add /.well-known/change-password by @matthieusieben in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12076
* Avoid per-frame Reanimated commits in the profile header by @tomekzaw in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12161
* Fix Android year picker step in the create-account E2E flow by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12163
* Fix profile header swallowing scroll swipes on Android by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12166
* [APP-3627] Fix "Go to profile" in the web account menu by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12162
* Update profile links blocklist by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12168
* Show where profile links go in the browser's status bar on web by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12147
* [APP-3619] Add more support sites to profile links by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12150
* Restore strict fingerprint preset after Expo 58 by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12170
* [APP-3615] Make the supported sites list scrollable on iOS by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12178
* [APP-3613] Keep web dialogs open when a text selection drag ends on the backdrop by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12177
* [APP-3618] Open profile links when tapped on your own profile by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12175
* [APP-3626] Fix double center column offset on web by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12164
* [APP-3625] Open bsky.app profile links in-app from the link details sheet by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12176
* Read your own profile links from the profile view by @vineyardbovines in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12181
* 🌎 Atmosphere explore tab by @estrattonbailey in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12188
* chore(deps): bump body-parser in bskylink and bskyogcard by @haileyok in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12190
* [APP-3660] Fix the EAS build cache for local native builds by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/12197
* Add a Trending Topics widget by @mozzius in https://github.com/bluesky-social/social-app/pull/11720
* Fix KeyboardAvoidingView stale init race
